texts.facts: 2. Learned APP strongly opposes the application for grant of any interim relief taking into consideration the sections under which the offence is registered. 3. Perusal of F.I.R. would show that it has been lodged by Food Safety Officer on 18.08.2021, which has a reference of the letter by Aurad Shahajani Police Station, Dist. Latur dated 17.08.2021, in which it was informed that, they had taken banned articles from the possession of the applicant on 15.08.2021.
